cards.title: Say tired
sections: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases. Join the sounds into one word without adding extra vowels.
Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.
cards.name: Everyday English - A1 - Day 147 - Pronunciation & Listening - 01

articulation.label: tired
articulation.alt: tired: /t/ → /aɪ/ → /r/ → /d/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ɪ/: Glide up and forward; narrow the jaw gap.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
